moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description:
Grass (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 75
Priority: 0
Causes the target to fall asleep.

moves.name: After You
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
The target makes its move immediately after the user this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target would have moved next anyway, or if the target already moved this turn.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description:
Poison (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description:
Grass (Special)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move still requires a turn to charge.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description:
Grass (Special)
Base Power: 130
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description:
Grass (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description:
Grass (Special)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

moves.name: Strength Sap
moves.description:
Grass (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage. The user restores its HP equal to the target's Attack stat calculated with its stat stage before this move was used. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. Fails if the target's Attack stat stage is -6.

moves.name: Pollen Puff
moves.description:
Bug (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If the target is an ally, this move restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down, instead of dealing damage.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Wide Lens
items.description: The accuracy of attacks by the holder is 1.1x.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: Occa Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fire-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Big Root
items.description: Holder gains 1.3x HP from draining/Aqua Ring/Ingrain/Leech Seed/Strength Sap.

items.name: Bright Powder
items.description: The accuracy of attacks against the holder is 0.9x.

items.name: Iron Ball
items.description: Holder is grounded, Speed halved. If Flying type, takes neutral Ground damage.

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.description: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Effect Spore
abilities.description: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned, paralyzed, or fall asleep.
